title: 随机链表的复制

en.title: Copy List with Random Pointer
constraints: Node.random is null or points to some node in the list

complexity.space: Interleaving method: O(1) extra space (excluding the new output list); an O(n) hash map approach also passes
complexity.notes: n is the number of nodes; the returned new list itself is not counted as extra space. Interleaving: insert each node's copy right after it, set each copy's random via orig->random->next, then split the two lists and restore the original. The largest test is the official limit n = 1000.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is the node count n; then n lines, each "2 val randomIndex" (2 is the number of integers that follow on the line; randomIndex -1 means null). stdout: line 1 is n; then n lines, each "val randomIndex" describing the copied list.

constraints: Node.random 为空或指向链表中的某个节点

complexity.space: 节点交织法 O(1) 额外空间（不计输出的新链表）；哈希表映射 O(n) 亦可通过
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为节点数，返回的新链表本身不计入额外空间。交织法：在每个原节点后插入其拷贝，借 orig->random->next 设置拷贝的 random，最后拆分两条链表并恢复原链表。最大测试为官方上限 n = 1000。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行节点数 n；随后 n 行，每行为「2 val randomIndex」（2 是该行后续整数个数，randomIndex 为 -1 表示空）。stdout：第一行 n；随后 n 行，每行「val randomIndex」描述复制后的链表。
